T: When somebody loved me, they fed me.
D: Woody is stolen by a toy collector and the gang sets out to rescue him.
P: Serve the cheese puffs when Al starts eating them in his apartment.
S: the orange dust on his fingers
Homemade cheese puffs: choux pastry with grated cheddar and gruyère, piped into rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed.
Woody's old TV show, Woody's Roundup

Beans slow-cooked with smoky bacon, onion, molasses, mustard and tomato until thick and sticky, served in tin mugs with cheesy cornbread crumbs. Fry 200g diced bacon until crisp, add 1 diced onion and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 x 400g tins drained cannellini beans, 400g tinned tomatoes, 2 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 250ml water. Cover and bake at 160C for 90 minutes, stirring once. Crumble 2 cornbread muffins with 40g cheddar and toast under the grill to scatter on top.
Jessie's horse with the big goofy grin
Caramels melted with a splash of cream until smooth, crisp apple wedges patted dry and dipped halfway, rolled in crushed roasted peanuts and set on baking paper in the fridge for 20 minutes.
M: Al's Toy Barn honey butter fried chicken
Al in his chicken suit on the Toy Barn TV ad

Buttermilk-brined drumsticks double-dredged and fried crunchy, drizzled with honey butter, with creamy coleslaw and pickles on the side. Soak 12 drumsticks overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt. Mix 250g plain flour with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and salt. Dredge, dip back in buttermilk and dredge again. Fry at 165C for 12 to 14 minutes until 75C inside. Melt 50g butter with 3 tbsp honey and drizzle over. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 carrot with 120g mayonnaise and vinegar.
Stinky Pete, still in his box
Beef chuck browned, onion, garlic, chipotle and cumin, tomatoes and beans, braised 3 hours. Sour cream and cornbread.
W: Jessie's cowgirl yodel on the old TV show
Butter sugar cookie dough chilled, rolled, cut into cowboy hats and boots, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced with red and white royal icing in Jessie's cowgirl colours.
K: a cowboy's drink at Woody's Roundup

Ice-cold sarsaparilla poured over vanilla ice cream until it foams, a drizzle of caramel down the glass and a cowboy-hat cookie on the rim. Drizzle 1 tbsp caramel sauce down the inside of each of 4 chilled tall glasses. Add 2 scoops vanilla ice cream to each. Pour 300ml cold sarsaparilla slowly down the side of each glass, letting the foam settle before topping up. Perch a cowboy-hat biscuit on each rim and serve with long spoons and straws.

s.note: the orange dust on his fingers
s.how: Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour and cook a minute. Cool, beat in 2 eggs, then 50g grated cheddar and 40g gruyère. Pipe small rounds and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed.

s.note: Jessie's horse with the big goofy grin
s.how: Melt 200g caramels with 2 tbsp cream until smooth. Cut 3 apples into wedges and pat dry. Dip halfway, roll in 60g crushed roasted peanuts and set on baking paper in the fridge for 20 minutes.

m.note: Stinky Pete, still in his box
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Add an onion, 3 garlic cloves, 2 chipotles in adobo and 2 tsp cumin, then 2 tins tomatoes and 2 tins kidney beans. Braise 3 hours. Serve with sour cream and squares of cornbread.

w.note: Jessie's cowgirl yodel on the old TV show
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Chill, roll and cut into cowboy hats and boots. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Ice with 300g icing sugar mixed with egg white, some tinted red, in cowgirl colours.

d.note: a cowboy's drink at Woody's Roundup
d.how: Drizzle 1 tbsp caramel sauce down the inside of each of 4 chilled tall glasses. Add 2 scoops vanilla ice cream to each. Pour 300ml cold sarsaparilla slowly down the side of each glass, letting the foam settle before topping up. Perch a cowboy-hat biscuit on each rim and serve with long spoons and straws.
